278:52.en: 「If this works, it'll be some show!」

278:164.en: 「$$マリーダ$$... I'm sorry...! I did nothing at all for you...!」

278:219.en: 「Whatever it is, whatever happens... promise me you'll come back to me, no matter what...」

278:429.en: 「I won't lose! Not to the word\n$$ニュータイプ$$, and not to myself...!」

278:496.en: 「I'll find how to change now, too...!」

278:582.en: 「The light she showed me...\nI won't waste it...!」

alternatives: I'll show you I can do it!

278:703.en: 「I won't let you go any further!」

278:736.en: 「I'll walk the path I believe in!」

278:848.en: 「If you're in a spot like that, then!」

278:1000.en: 「Lend me strength again, $$デルタプラス$$!」

278:1043.en: 「$$クシャトリヤ$$...!\nI'll master it, just watch!」

alternatives: I'll take this to close combat!
Let's take this to close combat!
I'm taking this to melee range!

278:1221.en: 「If I can just close the distance...!」

278:1418.en: 「You doubt human possibility, yet\nyou're the vessel of its consensus!?」

278:1475.en: 「$$フル・フロンタル$$,\nI'll pay for your karma!」

278:1530.en: 「You'd snuff out the light in hearts?\nWe'll stop you!」

278:1587.en: 「Spit out what's under that mask,\n$$フル・フロンタル$$!」

278:1687.en: 「That blind faith is dangerous!\nThat's why I have to stop you!」

278:1748.en: 「Even if $$フロンタル$$'s aide shows up!」

278:1789.en: 「I won't hand the Box to $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」

278:1826.en: 「$$ハマーン・カーン$$, this can't be what\nyou're supposed to be doing!」

278:1946.en: 「We'll buy the time until the talks!」

278:1979.en: 「Hate me if you want. But for now...!」

278:2014.en: 「I won't let $$サイデリアル$$ throw\ntheir weight around forever!」

278:2069.en: 「If you took it by force,\nwe'll take it back by force!」

278:2171.en: 「$$スフィア$$ power over events...!\nCan't drop my guard for a second!」

278:2230.en: 「$$皇帝アウストラリス$$!\nA defeated general suits you!」

278:2289.en: 「Even if the key to lifting the curse\nis with us, we won't hand it over!」

278:2356.en: 「I won't lose to a man who does\nnothing but curse his fate!」

278:2405.en: 「You warped the fate of Earthlings\nand my family... You, above all...!」

278:2468.en: 「Today's humanity has no need for\nintervention by emissaries of God!」

278:2523.en: 「I have no right to blame you...!\nBut I can't let you go, either!」

278:2596.en: 「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$!\nYou'll tell us all your schemes!」

278:2649.en: 「You won't take the path we trust...\nOr a future full of possibility!」

278:2720.en: 「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$!\nBehold our light of possibility!」

278:2775.en: 「No one else gives you a future.\nYou carve it out yourself!」

278:2842.en: 「I won't lose to a pet\ntamed by the $$御使い$$...!」

278:2891.en: 「$$バンシィ$$ has weapons like this too!」

278:3003.en: 「I'll leap into range in one go...!」

278:3165.en: 「I'll keep firing till you go down!」

278:3336.en: 「We aren't the only ones\nmaking this light!」

278:3406.en: 「I can feel it too, $$バナージ$$!」

278:3466.en: 「$$ユニコーン$$ and $$バンシィ$$,\nwe combine both our powers!」

278:3575.en: 「I should be able to use it now...!」

278:3982.en: 「Now it's your turn to play along!」

278:4017.en: 「Showing where you are was a mistake!」

278:4054.en: 「Like I'll let you just get away!」

278:4079.en: 「I can't let it end with me beaten!」

278:4263.en: 「Let me follow you, $$マリーダ・クルス$$!」

278:4335.en: 「Distracted by the $$ガランシェール$$ squad!」

278:4374.en: 「Now I understand...!\nWhat it means to sync up!」

278:4425.en: 「Hang in there! I'm on my way!」

278:4450.en: 「I'll be the shield! Fall back now!」

278:4487.en: 「Let me do at least this much!」

278:4545.en: 「I'll repay my debt, $$マリーダ・クルス$$!」

278:4621.en: 「I won't let $$ラー・カイラム$$ go down!」

278:4658.en: 「That disgraces the $$トライスター$$ name!」

278:4728.en: 「One at a time, I'll finish them!」

278:4786.en: 「I'll lead! The rest is up to you!」

278:4848.en: 「I don't intend to be just a decoy!」

278:4930.en: 「I'm not going to keep getting\nbeaten one-sidedly forever...!」

278:5156.en: 「Stay calm, and I can handle this...!」

278:5224.en: 「I could see the enemy's attack too!」

278:5255.en: 「$$フル・フロンタル$$!\nYour vessel can't amount to much!」

278:5316.en: 「Your ideal will end as a pipe dream,\n$$フル・フロンタル$$!」

278:5381.en: 「Is that it, $$フロンタル$$'s guard captain?」

278:5420.en: 「Hitting me won't do a thing here!」

278:5457.en: 「I don't intend to rely on the\nfield any more than this, but...!」

278:5650.en: 「No direct hits and I can do this...!」

278:5757.en: 「I was prepared to get hurt long ago」

278:5844.en: 「I let them set the pace too much...!」

278:5912.en: 「I'm fine...! I can still go on!」

278:5943.en: 「Pain is proof I'm alive...!\nI can still do this!」

278:6103.en: 「I won't let your darkness snuff out\n$$バンシィ$$'s light!」

278:6248.en: 「No matter how hopeless it gets,\nI've decided never to give up!」

278:6307.en: 「This life everyone held onto for me,\nI can't throw it away here...!」

278:6370.en: 「I can't end like this...!\nI haven't atoned for anything yet!」

278:6439.en: 「I don't mind losing my life...!\nBut I can't end here yet!」

278:6541.en: 「$$バンシィ$$!\nNeither of us can be done yet!」

278:6592.en: 「Sorry...! This is as far as I go...!」

278:6794.en: 「$$ミネバ$$... You... me...! I told you not to leave me alone...!」

278:6920.en: 「Let's do this, $$バナージ$$...! This light isn't something only we are producing!」

278:6993.en: 「Is this the perfected $$ニュータイプ$$...!?」

278:7034.en: 「You're so reckless...! Nobody wanted that kind of result! As long as there's a possibility, that's enough!」

278:7137.en: 「Both you and me! There must still be plenty we have to do in this world, right!? I'll bring you back, no matter what!」

278:7243.en: 「Think you can hold $$ミネバ$$ like that!? I'll steal $$オードリー$$ away! $$バナージ$$!」

278:7367.en: 「Take a good look in front of the screen, $$ミネバ$$! The players are watching this exchange!」

278:7448.en: 「There must still be players who don't know what the Box really is... And yet I can't just go and spoil it for them!」

278:7557.en: 「Damn! Why do they keep hitting me!?」

278:7608.en: 「...Both of them took off the moment they heard what you just said, Captain」

278:7663.en: 「Heh heh... Looks like the $$トライスター$$ aren't prepared enough either」

278:7812.en: 「I won't let anyone erase this light!」
